name: Key Exchange Response
definition: The KeyExchangeResponse message is sent by an acquirer, an issuer or an agent to answer to a KeyExchangeInitiation message and complete a cryptographic key exchange.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management.

KeyExchangeResponse.name: Key Exchange Response
KeyExchangeResponse.definition: Information related to the response to a key exchange.
